title: Locker Rental: limit on open rentals of a tier at a single club
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states the limit, at a single club, on how many open rentals of a given tier a single member may hold at the same time. The specific per-tier ceiling on that count is fixed in the Locker Rental membership eligibility and club access terms; this document states only the rule that applies that ceiling.

## Rule
A member may not hold, at the same club, more open rentals of a given tier than the maximum number of lockers of that tier permitted per club, as fixed for that tier. Renting a second locker at a club where the member already holds an open rental of any tier is not permitted, regardless of which tier the new rental would be, once the member is already at that tier's fixed ceiling for that club.

## Equivalent restatement
- Condition: the member already holds, at a given club, the maximum number of open rentals of a tier that is fixed for that tier.
- Judgement: a request to open another rental of any tier at that same club does not qualify.
- Action: the additional rental at that club is not permitted while the member remains at the fixed ceiling there.

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical)
- A member holds no open rental at a given club and requests one: this is within the ceiling, since the member has not yet reached the maximum fixed for the tier at that club.
- A member who is already at the maximum number of open rentals of a tier fixed for that club requests one more open rental at that same club, of any tier: this exceeds the ceiling and is not permitted.
- A member who is at the maximum fixed for one club requests an open rental of the same tier at a different club: this rule applies the ceiling per club, so a rental at a different club is judged against that other club's own count, not against the first club's.
